spans.s: khāṭikā (Ep. Ind., Vol. IV, p. 253); the mouth of a river; same as Bengali khād̤ī.
khaṭvā, cf. a-kūra-chullaka-vināśi-khaṭv-āvāsa (IE 8-5); a cot which the villagers were obliged to provide for a touring officer of the king.
khaṭvāṅga (EI 5; SII 2), a club with a skull fixed at the top; a Śaiva emblem.
